args.body: At each existing CSV and welfare experiment checkpoint, use the latest permitted aggregate evidence and any authorized redacted case receipt to make the recorded continue/change/stop decision. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the host's independent review gate. Reuse committed checkpoint work and avoid a repeat catalogue placement search absent a documented invitation.
